desc:
FRUIT FLAVORED SNACKS: Fruit Roll-Ups Jolly Rancher Variety Pack features Watermelon and Green Apple flavors; With wild flavors and colors, the possibilities for fun are endless

FUN KIDS SNACK: These packaged snack bags are the perfect treat to include in a packed school lunch box; Each roll comes with an assortment of tongue tattoos for wacky fun

GLUTEN FREE: Tasty treats made without gluten for snacks you can feel great about

ON-THE-GO SNACK: These Fruit Flavored Snacks are the perfect addition to your pantry and a snack every member of the family will love

CONTAINS: 0.5 oz, 10 ct (Pack of 10)
features:
Key Features:

Jolly Rancher-Inspired Flavors

Includes Watermelon and Green Apple flavors, offering a fruity and candy-like taste experience.

Fun & Interactive

Each roll comes with a temporary tongue tattoo for added excitement, especially for kids.

Soft, Chewy Texture

Easy to eat and unwrap, with a playful peel-and-eat format.

Gluten-Free & Gelatin-Free

Suitable for those with dietary restrictions or specific ingredient preferences.

Individually Wrapped

Convenient single-serve packs, ideal for lunchboxes, on-the-go snacks, or portion control.

Supports Educational Programs

Participates in the Box Tops for Education program, helping schools with every purchase.

Benefits:

Perfect for Kids

Bright colors, fun tattoos, and familiar candy-inspired flavors make them a hit with children.

Convenient Snacking

Easy to carry, store, and pack without mess or fuss.

Low in Calories

Each roll is only 50 calories, great for light snacking or portion-controlled treats.

Quick Vitamin C Source

Contains 10% of the recommended daily intake of Vitamin C per serving.

Allergy-Friendly Choice

Free from gluten, gelatin, and most major allergens.
ingredients: Corn Syrup, Sugar, Pear Puree, Maltodextrin, Palm and/or Palm Kernel Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Monoglycerides, Fruit Pectin, Malic Acid, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Natural Flavor, Color (red 40, yellows 5 & 6, blue 1).
